note: The program spike's third round (operator, 2026-11-13), on the spike branch only: nothing of it merges before the spike is adopted. One new image built from the spike branch at 06460198 (stack 3c6717a), which adds to round 2: on the codex program arms a turn's message carries the scratchpad whole only on a thread's first message, after a compaction, or after the pad changed outside the conversation (D8; the fixed loop is unchanged); a refusal is no reason to wake once a tool result has carried its hint, matched by signature, a death once a dead hint reported it, and a wake() call once the routine lines showed its run over or replaced; saves sent together restart a running routine once, and a start of a routine its save just restarted is answered as that run; read_file takes an optional line range; only async exports are routines; the program prompt says a routine in another file must be exported from main.ts and that every file holds at most 32,000 characters; a snippet's read of a workspace file off the sandbox's disk names read_file; the walk-budget note drops its background-routine advice; each wake record carries its block.
